scenario: A coral-reef study stores dive observations only if survey duration exceeds 4 hours. The project lead wants the mean survey duration across all dives.

data.description: Only dives longer than 4 hours are logged. Duration is Normal with known sigma 1 hour.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean survey duration mu across all dives and (b) the fraction of dives recorded.
naive_answer: Average survey duration is about 4.47 hours because that is the log mean.
naive_trap: Shorter dives are omitted from the dataset.
reasoning_trace: With alpha≈1.3, mu=4-1.3=2.7 and the recorded fraction is about 0.0968.
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(4-mu)/1; return mu+norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-4.47
mu=brentq(eq,-10,3.99)
frac=norm.sf((4-mu)/1)
assert abs(mu-2.7)<0.1 and abs(frac-0.0968)<0.005
